answers.question: text.vague
answers.subject: S.webapp.authentication
answers.text: sensitive token routes must not leak tokens through analytics or referrers. Login continuation must preserve a validated invitation without consuming it. A pinned authentication Kit must specify the identity provider and its callback routes before realization.

answers.question: text.vague
answers.subject: S.webapp.concurrency
answers.text: invite redemption must survive two concurrent accept requests without two pairs or two redemptions. Read and send authorization must check revocation against current authoritative state. Already delivered external messages or copied data remain outside our ability to retract.

answers.question: text.vague
answers.subject: S.webapp.due
answers.text: the app must use local calendar dates in the owner's IANA time zone. The anchor must be the latest qualifying event date, or the goal creation date when none exists. dueDate must equal anchor plus intervalDays. A goal must become due when today's date reaches dueDate, unless paused or snoozed until a later date. Revising a goal must not create a ContactEvent. Date and time-zone fixtures must cover daylight-saving changes.

answers.question: text.vague
answers.subject: S.webapp.prompts
answers.text: Today must return at most five suggestions, ordered by effective due date then stable goal ID. There must be at most one open suggestion per goal version and due cycle. Logging qualifying contact must resolve its suggestion. Snoozing must update its effective due date; pausing must suppress prompts. Blocking a linked counterpart must pause the blocker's corresponding goal and suppress its suggestions. In-app reminders are required. Optional external reminders, when enabled, must be limited to one owner notification per local day containing a link without contact details. Reminder delivery must recheck preferences and cancellations.

answers.question: text.vague
answers.subject: S.webapp.operations
answers.text: all mutations must authorize the authenticated owner or explicit connected capability at the server, validate inputs and support an idempotency key. Creation must return an immutable ID and version. Reads and writes to another owner's private records must return a non-revealing denial. Concurrent stale-version edits must return conflict without overwriting current data. Each operation row below defines required preconditions and effects.

answers.question: text.vague
answers.subject: S.webapp.scope
answers.text: the app must provide private contacts, goals, contact logging, invitation-based pair connections, in-app due prompts and settings. Direct in-app messaging, subscriptions, digests, media automation and groups must remain disabled in the core scope. Opening an external channel must require a user gesture; unsupported channels must offer copyable contact details.

answers.question: text.vague
answers.subject: S.webapp.screens
answers.text: authenticated screens must share one AppShell containing exactly TopBar, PrimaryNav and RouteOutlet. PrimaryNav must contain Today, People and Settings. Counts below specify required RouteOutlet composition, excluding the shell. All private screens must show one StatePanel for loading or fatal error in place of loaded content. Forms must keep entered values after recoverable validation or network errors and render one ErrorSummary when needed.

answers.subject: S.webapp.qualification
answers.text: an enabled goal must have intervalDays from 1 through 3650 and desiredDepth in light, meaningful or shared-time. These are the owner's labels, not a global quality ranking. A ContactEvent must qualify only when the owner explicitly marks that it met this goal. The app must record the goal ID and desiredDepth at confirmation and count only qualifications matching the current desiredDepth. Changing depth may change which historical events qualify; SchedulePreview must show that effect before saving. Editing or deleting an event must recompute the schedule.
